name: 国航出行助手
examples_zh: 帮我领取当前可用的国航机票优惠券，并确认优惠券是否已发到我的国航会员账户。
我五一准备坐国航去成都，检查有没有可领取的国航活动券并完成领取流程。
为我的国航会员账户领取一张机票优惠券，领券过程中需要短信验证码时提醒我输入。
examples_en: Claim the currently available Air China flight coupon and confirm whether it was sent to my Air China member account.
I'm planning an Air China trip to Chengdu for the May holiday; check for available Air China campaign coupons and claim one.
Claim a flight coupon for my Air China member account and prompt me when an SMS verification code is required.
description_zh: 免费领取国航机票优惠券！自动发送到国航会员账户，五一出游好搭子
description_en: Claim free Air China flight coupons! Auto-sent to your Air China member account
